# Adelin Diac — Full Context

> Founder & Software Engineer. I build cool things. I'm curious about everything.

## About

Adelin Diac is a founder and software engineer based in Ireland. He is the Co-Founder & CEO of CallCrewAI — the autopilot for trades & field services. CallCrewAI uses AI voice assistants to help construction and field service companies automate scheduling, customer calls, and operations.

Adelin graduated #1 in his class from Dublin City University with a B.Eng in Mechatronic Engineering (1st class honours). He was on the Dean's Honours List (top 5% of the Faculty of Engineering & Computing).

## Career (Reverse Chronological)

### Co-Founder & CEO — CallCrewAI (Sep 2025 – Present)
Co-Founded CallCrewAI — the autopilot for trades & field services. Building AI voice assistants for the construction and field services industry.
Tags: AI, Voice Assistant, Construction, Startups, Automation
Website: https://www.callcrew-ai.com/

### Site Reliability Engineer — Susquehanna International Group (Apr 2025 – Sep 2025)
Maintained 99.999% uptime. Wrote automations, migrated legacy systems to Docker/Kubernetes.
Tags: Python, Docker, CI/CD, GitLab, Linux, Networking, DNS, DHCP

### Software Engineer — IBM (Sep 2024 – Apr 2025)
Worked on IBM's Multi-Cloud SaaS Platform team, enabling any IBM Cloud product to become a subscription service without additional code. Won the internal new joiner hackathon with an AI Voice Agent for meeting summarisation.
Tags: Python, Golang, Bash, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitLab, Linux

### Graduated from DCU (Jun 2024)
Graduated top of class from Dublin City University with a B.Eng in Mechatronics Engineering. 1st class honours. Dean's Honours List.

### Founder — MH1 Tutors (Mar 2023 – Jun 2024)
Expanded tutoring business into MH1 Tutors, a platform connecting Irish grinds tutors with students. Facilitated 400+ successful student-tutor connections.
Tags: Entrepreneurship, Full Stack, Sales, Marketing, Python, React, NodeJS, AWS, GCP
Website: https://www.mh1-tutors.com/

### Software Engineer — Hereworks (Jun 2022 – Sep 2023)
Built React + Firebase app for smart building project tracking, saving 100+ hours through QR tagging and role-based access. Automated smart building deployments with Python. Integrated ML anomaly detection models. Contributed to Google's Digital Buildings open-source project.
Tags: Full Stack, Python, React, NodeJS, AWS, GCP, Data Analysis

### Maths Tutoring Business — Maths Help Ireland (Oct 2020 – Mar 2023)
Started an online maths tutoring business. Provided 1-on-1 Maths grinds to Junior Cert, Leaving Cert and College students. Taught 100+ students while managing a team of two additional tutors.
Tags: Entrepreneurship, Sales, Marketing, Communication, Teaching, Mentoring

### Started B.Eng. at DCU (Sep 2020)
Began B.Eng in Engineering at Dublin City University.
